description: Department Of Forest Conservation - Amended Extra Ordinary Gazettes No.2375/34 Dated 19th January 2023, Forest Conservation Ordinance.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves amendments to the Forest Conservation Ordinance and notifications regarding reserved forests. It constitutes legal/regulatory matters as it modifies existing regulations, repeals and substitutes specific provisions in previous gazette notifications, and exercises statutory powers under established legislation. While a minister is named, this is in the context of exercising legal authority rather than announcing personnel changes or detailing ministerial portfolios, making it a regulatory action rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
